result.one_liner: Real-time communication platform with APIs to build bots, integrations, and applications within Discord servers and direct messages

evidence.quote: Bot users are authenticated using the bot token found in your app's settings
Your application exchanges the authorization code received from the redirect for an access token
Register a developer application and retrieve your client ID and client secret
The HTTP API is a REST API that lets you interact and modify core Discord resources
Official Discord Developer Docs with complete REST API reference and OAuth2 authentication

result.notes: Discord offers fully public REST API with self-serve free tier access. Developers can register applications and obtain bot tokens or use OAuth2 flows. No GraphQL API. Community MCP servers available but no official vendor MCP. Suitable for building agent toolkits today.
